source: Authored by the build agent from a read of the corpus (271 Legistar letters across 10 matters, 164 simulated emails), not by IBM Bob: Bob could not run on this machine (no BOB_API_KEY, license not accepted). Maintained by the .bob/skills/categorize-comments skill once Bob can run.
stance_definition: Stance is the writer's position on the action, proposal, item or candidate the comment is about: support = asks the City to approve/do/fund/appoint it; oppose = asks the City not to, or objects to the City's current handling; neutral = gives information or asks a question without taking a side, or is explicitly undecided/mixed; unclear = cannot be told from the text (e.g. 'see attached' with no content).

categories.label: Immigrant community safety and rights
categories.description: Protecting immigrant residents regardless of national origin or legal status: the Feb 2025 resolution reaffirming the City's commitment (25-081), the Rules Committee immigrant-protection memo, welcoming/sanctuary policy, deportation fears, immigrant rights organizations' positions.
include: Letters for or against the safety-and-dignity resolution or the Ortiz/Campos/Cohen/Candelas memo
Comments about mass deportation, ICE, undocumented residents, sanctuary or welcoming-city policy
Immigrant rights organizations commenting on intergovernmental priorities that concern immigrants
exclude: General policing or crime without an immigration angle (public_safety)
State tax or budget lobbying positions (governance_budget)
examples: critical actions to protect our city's residents from the harmful policies of the incoming presidential administration
Resolution Reaffirming the City's Commitment to Preserving the Safety and Dignity of all its Residents
stands with its immigrant communities

categories.label: Public safety, policing and 911 response
categories.description: Crime, police staffing and budgets, response times, alternative and co-response programs for 911 calls (25-018, 25-085), surveillance cameras and license-plate readers, crime prevention programs.
include: Alternative response / co-response / mental-health crisis response to 911 calls
Car break-ins, burglaries, catalytic converter theft, police response times, police budget
Surveillance cameras, license-plate readers, community service officers, youth crime-prevention programs
exclude: Fear of the dark caused by streetlight outages where the ask is to fix the lights (streets_infrastructure)
examples: Options for Expanding Alternative Response and Co-Response Programs to 911 Calls for Service
car break-ins on my Naglee Park block almost weekly
I OPPOSE any police budget cut

categories.label: Housing, tenants and homelessness
categories.description: Rent stabilization and rent caps, tenant protections, habitability (no hot water, mold), eviction, affordable-housing finance (housing revenue bonds, 25-054), housing supply and upzoning/fourplex reform, homelessness, RV supportive parking (25-008), encampments.
include: Rent cap / rent ordinance amendment, eviction, tenant retaliation, landlord costs
Habitability complaints from tenants and proactive rental inspection
Upzoning / fourplexes / ADUs as housing supply policy; affordable-housing bonds and developers
Homelessness, encampments, RV safe-parking programs, Housing First
exclude: Permit processing delays for an individual project (land_use_permits_code)
Dumping where the ask is cleanup (sanitation_dumping), even if an encampment is mentioned in passing
examples: I'm writing to SUPPORT the amendment to lower the annual rent-increase cap
Tenants at Cedar Court Apartments near Tully Road have had NO hot water for nine days
Supportive Parking for Recreational Vehicles

categories.label: Streets, streetlights and drainage
categories.description: Physical public infrastructure: streetlight outages and the streetlight contract, potholes and road repair funding, sidewalks, storm drains and street flooding, transportation and transit funding asks.
include: Streetlights out, copper wire theft from streetlights, LED/smart-light contracts
Potholes, repaving, road-repair levies, sidewalks, curb and gutter
Storm drains backing up, street flooding, surface drainage
Requests to fund active transportation, Vision Zero or transit
exclude: Flood risk from a proposed development (land_use_permits_code)
examples: the streetlights along King Road between Story and Tully have been out
There is a huge pothole on Alma Avenue
the storm drain backs up and water reaches the driveways

categories.label: Illegal dumping, trash and blight cleanup
categories.description: Illegal dumping, debris along creeks and trails, bulky-item pickup, cleanup crews, graffiti and litter.
include: Dumped mattresses or construction debris, creek and trail trash
Free dump days, bulky-item pickup, dumping cameras and fines, volunteer cleanups
exclude: Blighted or derelict buildings on private property (land_use_permits_code)
examples: a huge pile of mattresses and construction debris dumped along the Coyote Creek trail
I SUPPORT more free bulky-item pickup and dump days
Hay mucha basura y escombros tirados

categories.label: Development, permits and code enforcement
categories.description: Non-residential land-use decisions (the Terra Verde data center and its EIR, commercial rezoning), building and business permit delays and fees, and code enforcement operations including derelict or blighted buildings (25-065).
include: Data center proposals, EIR certification, rezoning a parcel for retail
Permit delays, permit fees, online permitting, inspection backlogs (ADU, solar, small business)
Code enforcement operations, derelict or burned buildings, blighted properties
exclude: Citywide housing-supply zoning such as fourplex reform (housing_homelessness)
examples: I am strongly OPPOSED to the proposed Terra Verde data center off Gold Street
My ADU permit has been 'in review' for EIGHT months
Code Enforcement Operations Study Session

categories.label: Council governance, appointments and legislative priorities
categories.description: How the City is governed and funded: the District 3 interim appointment (25-059) and candidates, boards and commissions appointments (25-025), the City's state/federal legislative program and lobbying positions (25-011, 25-012), voter thresholds for taxes, City budget and fees in general.
include: Letters for or against an interim council candidate or about the appointment process
Positions on the legislative program, intergovernmental relations, lowering voter thresholds, Proposition 13
General City budget, taxes and fees not tied to one service
exclude: A budget ask for one specific service (put it in that service's category)
examples: I am writing in support of Danielle Christian for the interim appointment to the District Three seat
Please vote no to lowering voter thresholds for taxes
Interim Appointment to Council District 3

categories.label: Community services, hardship and other
categories.description: Everything else residents raise: personal economic hardship (job loss, medical debt, cost of living), senior centers and other community services, air quality and environment near freeways, parks, and messages too short or too vague to place elsewhere.
include: Job loss, medical debt, cost of living, requests for help navigating services
Senior center hours, youth or library services not framed as crime prevention
Air quality, sound walls, trees, parks
Attachments-only or one-line messages whose topic cannot be placed elsewhere
exclude: Any comment that clearly fits one of the other seven categories
examples: i got laid off from a warehouse near monterey rd in april
I'm drowning in medical debt
the air near my place by 101 is visibly hazy
